title: A git timeout is reported as EXTRACTION_TIMEOUT, whose fix hint says 'Raise timeout_seconds above N or reduce the input so extraction finish
description: A git timeout is reported as EXTRACTION_TIMEOUT, whose fix hint says 'Raise timeout_seconds above N or reduce the input so extraction finishes in time.' This misleads the user. The git deadline (GIT_DEADLINE, 60 s, git.rs) is a fixed constant and the doc says it is 'not configurable'. No timeout_seconds setting exists for it, so the user cannot act on the first half of the hint. The git call may also be a rev read, a repo-root discovery or hash-object. 'Reduce the input' does not describe a hung or slow git (a stuck lock, a network filesystem, a huge repo). The Display text 'extraction timed out after 60s' also names the wrong stage.
